details: Part of the team that oversees the development of Windows Presentation Framework (WPF) a desktop application development framework for Windows that ships with .NET SDK. WPF being opensourced, I work with the community, respond to issues, PRs, and fix bugs in the framework.

Co-developed and designed the OpenFolderDialog API for WPF, facilitating design discussions and securing approval from the review committee. Reviewed the feature's PR, authored a blog post, created a sample app, wrote documentation for better understanding and added unit and integration tests to ensure quality and performance.

Developed an efficient pipeline using various tools and scripts to reduce time taken in open-sourcing the test infrastructure. Enabled unit test on build pipelines, which allows contributors to validate their bug fixes and PRs.

Extended an internal debug tool, a desktop application developed using the WPF framework, that aggregates data from various sources. Implemented customizable command polling, wrote module for parsing the responses received and added shell-like command autocompletion features. Wrote unit and integration tests to validate the added features.
Developed REST API endpoints for Android apps, enhancing database for user reviews using PostgreSQL and Django REST Framework.
